name: model-router
description: Routes every Claude Code turn to the cheapest model that can do it well (Haiku lookups, Sonnet execution, Opus decisions), lets the model escalate itself, routes subagents too, keeps a warm cache when switching would cost more, and compares costs with the same work tokens at Opus prices. Classification runs on your own Anthropic account; no third party sees your prompts.

language.title: Reason language
language.description: Language of the routing reason and the price comparison in the band (en = English, zh = Simplified Chinese)

mainRouting.title: Route the main conversation
mainRouting.description: On (the default): every turn you start is classified and runs on the cheapest model that fits. Off: subagent-only mode, the low-risk way to start. The main thread is left on your own model (Fable included), and subagent routing, escalation, Fable blocking for subagents and the meter keep working.

blockFable.title: Block Fable
blockFable.description: On (the default): Fable never runs on a subagent, and never on the main conversation while main routing is on; those requests run on your Decision model instead. With main routing off, your own main model is left alone and only subagents are kept off Fable. Off: Fable is left alone everywhere, so you can run Fable as your main model; a subagent still never runs above its parent.

reviewModel.title: Decision reviewer
reviewModel.description: Optional: reviews Opus's decisions with a model id available on your account, only if it exists there (checked daily). The reviewer is sent your request and Opus's answer unmasked. Empty (the default) turns the review off. Fable 5.1 is never used.

idleCompactMinutes.title: Idle compact after (minutes)
idleCompactMinutes.description: 0 (the default) is off. 1 to 55: after this many idle minutes at the prompt, compact the main conversation while the 1-hour prompt cache is still warm, so coming back later rewrites a small context instead of a huge one. Only when the context is at least the Compact minimum context and no background agent is running; a new prompt cancels it. The timer moves forward when needed to leave a 3-minute cache margin plus 30 seconds of scheduling headroom, with at least 1 minute at the prompt. Values outside 1 to 55 count as off.

compactMinContext.title: Compact minimum context (tokens)
compactMinContext.description: The idle compact only runs when the main context is at least this many tokens; a smaller one is cheap to rewrite and not worth a summary.

checkpointHints.title: Suggest task-boundary checkpoints
checkpointHints.description: Suggest /model-router checkpoint after a main turn when the context is large enough and estimated future cache-read savings exceed the summary cost. Never compacts automatically. Off by default.

shrinkToolOutput.title: Reduce large tool output (characters)
shrinkToolOutput.description: 0 (the default) and values below 20000 are off. Otherwise reduce large Bash and MCP text logs, preserving diagnostics and archiving the exact original locally. Read, Edit, Write, Grep, Glob, code and diffs are left alone. fetch_output retrieves archived slices within the same character cap.

compactAtContext.title: Compact at context (tokens)
compactAtContext.description: 0 (the default) is off; below 100000 also counts as off (the engine's own auto-compact window starts there). Otherwise, when a main turn ends with the context at or above this many tokens (for example 200000), compact it between turns while the cache is warm, so each later step does not re-read a huge cache.
